vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who loves watching sports

vocabulary.meaning_en: an American game played with a bat and a ball by two teams

vocabulary.meaning_en: quick; moving at high speed

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who plays a game or sport

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you remember from the past
vocabulary.example: This photo brings back happy memories.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where the batter stands in baseball

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move the bat to hit the ball

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large group of people

vocabulary.meaning_en: to sit on and control a bicycle or horse
vocabulary.example: I really want to learn how to ride a bike.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where you buy tickets

vocabulary.meaning_en: with no more tickets or items left to buy
vocabulary.example: The tickets are sold out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: more than you need
vocabulary.example: Does anyone have an extra ticket?

vocabulary.meaning_en: on the internet
vocabulary.example: You should buy your ticket online.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: غير معدود: لا نقول an advice؛ نقول a piece of advice.
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable: say "some advice" or "a piece of advice", not "an advice".
vocabulary.example: Thanks. It is good advice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after the right time

fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice اسم (نصيحة) ويُنطق بصوت /s/ في آخره. advise فعل (ينصح) ويُنطق بصوت /z/. advice غير معدود.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Advice is a noun and ends with an /s/ sound. Advise is a verb and ends with a /z/ sound. Advice is uncountable.

examples.sentence: I advise you to buy your ticket online.

fine_lines.title: should vs ought to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى تقريباً واحد: نصيحة. should أشيع وأقصر وتأتي بعدها الفعل مباشرة. ought to تأتي معها to دائماً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They mean almost the same: advice. Should is more common and comes directly before the verb. Ought to always has "to".

examples.sentence: You should buy your ticket online.
You ought to take the Metro.

fine_lines.title: than vs then
fine_lines.explanation_ar: than للمقارنة (faster than). then = ثم / بعد ذلك (للترتيب في الزمن).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Than is for comparing (faster than). Then means next / after that.

examples.sentence: A taxi is faster than a bus.
I run to third base, then home plate.

expressions.example: Hi, Sara! Where are you going?

expressions.meaning_en: Advice not to use the bus.
expressions.example: Don't take the bus. It's very slow today.
Wait a minute. This won't take long.

expressions.meaning_en: A shout when a player hits a home run.
expressions.example: He hit the ball out of the park. It's a home run!
"Did you buy a ticket?" "No, not yet."
What do you mean, you can't ride a bike?
We were too late. The tickets were sold out.

expressions.phrase: Next time, you should buy your ticket online.
expressions.meaning_ar: في المرة القادمة، يجب أن تشتري تذكرتك عبر الإنترنت.
expressions.example: Next time, you should come earlier.

expressions.phrase: Being early is better than being late.
expressions.meaning_ar: أن تأتي مبكراً أفضل من أن تتأخر.
expressions.meaning_en: It is good to arrive before the start time.
expressions.example: Leave home now. Being early is better than being late.

grammar.title: Comparative adjectives + than
grammar.explanation_ar: للمقارنة بين شيئين: الصفة القصيرة + er + than: fast → faster than. الصفة المنتهية بـ y: early → earlier. الصفات الشاذة: good → better، bad → worse. والصفات الطويلة: more + الصفة + than (more expensive than).
grammar.explanation_en: To compare two things: short adjective + -er + than: fast → faster than. Adjectives ending in -y: early → earlier. Irregular: good → better, bad → worse. Long adjectives: more + adjective + than (more expensive than).
examples: A taxi is faster than a bus.
A bicycle is faster than a taxi in D.C. traffic.
You should go a lot earlier than 7 o'clock.
Being early is better than being late.

grammar.title: a lot + comparative
grammar.explanation_ar: لتقوية المقارنة نضع a lot أو much قبل الصفة المقارنة: a lot faster = أسرع بكثير.
grammar.explanation_en: To make a comparison stronger, put a lot or much before the comparative: a lot faster.
examples: The Metro was a lot faster than a bus.
Go a lot earlier than 7 o'clock.

grammar.title: Advice with should / ought to
grammar.explanation_ar: should + الفعل الأساسي، و ought to + الفعل الأساسي، للنصيحة. النفي: shouldn't. لا نقول should to.
grammar.explanation_en: Use should + base verb or ought to + base verb for advice. Negative: shouldn't. Don't say "should to".
examples: You should go a lot earlier.
You ought to take the Metro.
You shouldn't take a taxi in heavy traffic.

questions.question: A taxi is ___ than a bus.
questions.explanation_en: To compare two things: faster than.

questions.question: Being early is ___ than being late.

choices: You ought to take the Metro.

questions.question: "The tickets are sold out" means:

questions.question: In baseball, the batter stands at ___.
questions.explanation_en: The batter stands at home plate.

questions.explanation_en: If tickets sell out, the useful advice is: next time, buy your ticket online.
